method: REA/Ghidra raw slices, corroborated by original-PE Windows x64 instructions; bounded unchanged-instruction Unicorn checks.

contracts.ordering: An optional leading row followed by all saved56-byte rows in source order; no eligibility filter in these owners.
contracts.level: Roster best_level is clamped to1..60 for the client preview.
contracts.zone: The selected connection zone descriptor supplies map/area and XYZ for every row. addon-zones-0.105.0.json owns current map/area IDs; bounded checks revalidate the reused run-entry-0.100.1.json map/spawn values against current bytes.
contracts.appearance: Per-row race/class/sex/features; equipment projects saved class/race gear through14588c920,1458bd260 and140070120. These callee internals are not independently revalidated by the bounded checker.
contracts.wire_constants: After coordinates: guild0, flags0, first-login0, pet display/level/family0; displaylevel>=1 means protocol new_character=false.

limitations: String deep cloning is an explicit metadata-copy seam in the collector check; allocator and gear callees do not execute.
Raw Ghidra slices use generic ABI/types and lack full data; original PE assembly establishes actual register/field bindings.
No source compilation, game launch or original/rebuilt screen or input comparison.
